target.statement: SoftHAD mean anomaly agreement score (AUC) of 81.3% on synthetic dataset D1, averaged over 100 runs
target.table_ref: Table I, row SoftHAD, column Dataset D1
target.dataset: Synthetic D1 (mixture of multivariate Gaussians, 500+500 train/test, 3% label noise)

compute.basis: Synthetic data is generated from described Gaussian mixtures; method is a closed-form linear solve on ~1000-node graphs, so 100 runs of 1000x1000 solves plus baselines fit easily on CPU, but all code (data generator, SoftHAD, baselines) must be written from scratch.

blockers: No code released; data generator and all methods must be reimplemented from the paper text
Exact Gaussian parameters for D1 not fully specified, so exact 81.3% may not be matched
title: Conditional anomaly detection with soft harmonic functions
